subject: SLO uplift & support tier at renewal — OpenHealth contract
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@openhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: Support uplift & latency SLO request

Hi Ben,

We're approaching our renewal on 2027-01-15 and the execs want to discuss upgrading our support tier and adding a stronger latency SLO for our core inference traffic. Over the past 6 months we've tripled qps and see tail-latency spikes that impact customer-facing features.

High-level asks:
- Move to Priority (premium) support
- Add a 99.9% p95 latency SLO for request/response under 1k tokens (or equivalent latency banding)
- Reserve an additional 40% capacity for peak windows (Nov–Feb burst)
- Clarify credits/termination terms if SLAs aren't met

Attached: current_usage_report.csv

Can we get a ballpark on pricing and possible term trade-offs? Kyle (cc) will own procurement.

Thanks,
Samantha Liu
Head of Platform, OpenHealth
samantha.liu@openhealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@openhealth.com>
Cc: Kyle Rogers <kyle.rogers@openhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: Support uplift & latency SLO request

Thanks Samantha — this is very clear and helpful.

Quick proposal:
- Priority support (+24/7 oncall, 1-hour P1 response) as the support tier
- SLO: 99.9% p95 latency target for the configured inference route; we'll define measurement windows and sampling
- Reserved capacity: +40% burst pool with an occupancy billing model (credits for unused reservation)

I'll put together a short mutual action plan and a pricing TE to share. Monica — can you own the onramp + pilot ops runbook? Laura — I'll sync with you for commercial terms and a 24-month discount ladder idea.

Attached: proposed_ma_v1.pdf (draft timeline & owners)

When's a good time next week for a 30-min alignment? I'm available Tues/Wed 10–2 PT.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: Support uplift & latency SLO request

Ben / Laura —

Happy to own the technical onramp. A few operational notes to flag before we commit to 99.9% p95:
- Measurement: we'll need to agree on route definitions and synthetic vs production sampling; recommend 1% uniform sampling plus full tail capture for high-QPS buckets.
- Pilot: 4-week pilot with dedicated telemetry hooks (traces + token-level breakdowns) to baseline current tail behavior; if pilot shows >10% variance, we'll propose a staged SLO with remediation playbooks.
- Capacity: reserved burst will be carved from our Dedicated pool; we should discuss pre-warming windows and autoscale thresholds.

Attaching a stub runbook we can iterate: ops_runbook_stub.txt

Aditya — can you confirm infra changes for reservation and whether we can offer a credits-for-unused reservation model? I recall a custom proposal we used for Kestrel last year.

—Monica

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@openhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Kyle Rogers <kyle.rogers@openhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: Support uplift & latency SLO request

Thanks — this sounds promising.

Procurement questions from our side:
- Term: would Redwood consider a 24-month committed term in exchange for discounted reserved capacity pricing?
- Credits: we want a clear credits schedule if SLOs are missed (not just service credits — ideally offset against overage charges)
- Audit: our security/compliance team will need a short SOC2 evidence packet and API audit log retention details (we can share a questionnaire)

Attached: procurement_requirements.pdf

If you can include a ballpark in the MA for a 24-month path + pricing, Kyle and I can prep for legal.

Best,
Samantha

Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: Support uplift & latency SLO request

Samantha — thanks for the procurement note and the requirements doc.

Summary / next steps (agreed in principle):
1) Term: 24-month committed term available; we'll offer a 12% discount on reserved capacity pricing for a 24-month commitment vs 12-month.
2) Support & SLO: Priority support + SLO (99.9% p95) with a staged pilot; credits for missed SLOs will be applied as overage offsets per the MA (we'll outline exact credit schedule).
3) Capacity: Reserved +40% burst carved from Dedicated pool; pre-warm windows to be defined in the runbook.
4) Compliance: Monica to assemble SOC 2 evidence packet and retention policy; we'll provide API audit log retention details.

I've updated the mutual action plan with ballpark pricing and put a placeholder DocuSign link for legal to review. Can we lock a 30-min call on Thu 12/02 11:00 PT to finalize the MA before Kyle takes it to legal? If that works I'll send the invite.

Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
Draft MA: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cMA-Proposal

Thanks everyone — looking forward to closing this for Q4 of our renewal cycle.

Ben Carter
